question: Who among the following has written 'Climate Change Explained - for one and all', an e-book released in May 2021 which explains the impact of climate change?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Aakash Ranison.**__

__** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] Key Points__**

__
 
• **Aakash Ranison** has written 'Climate Change Explained - for one and all', an e-book released in May 2021 which explains the impact of climate change.

 
 
• Aakash Ranison, the climate activist and blogger, has released this book.​
 
 

 
• **Amitav Ghosh** is a famous Indian writer who has won the Jnanpith Award__ for his contribution in the field of literature.

 
 
• Sea of Poppies, The Hungry Tide and River of Smoke are all written by** Amitav Ghosh.**
